title: Key (Crèche Cliffside Entrance)

sources.title: Crèche Y'llek
markers: | summary = It is a [[Githyanki]] base located directly under [[Rosymorn Monastery]] and can be reached through one of two [[#Connected locations|entrances]].

summary: Opens the cliffside entrance to Crèche Y’llek. It does not open the four main checkpoint gates.

fields.Acquisition: Copies are in the Blue Jay’s nest, on a table above the eastern jail cell, and with Warrior Qen.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
